description: FDA drug facts by brand/generic name or NDC from openFDA: label sections (boxed warning, indications, dosage, contraindications, warnings, adverse reactions, interactions, or any SPL field), FAERS adverse-event report totals with serious count and top reported reactions, and the latest enforcement recalls with class and reason. Not for clinical use; the response carries FDA's disclaimer. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/openfda-drug

include.description: Comma list of label, events, recalls (default all)

name.description: Brand or generic drug name (alias: drug)

ndc.description: Alternative: product NDC (0573-0164) or package NDC (0573-0164-30)

sections.description: Comma list of openFDA label fields, or "all" (default: key safety sections)
